title: Where our documents live
summary: No changes you will notice. The guides for people who work on the intranet now say where documents are kept.

changed: The guides for people who work on the intranet now keep every development document beside the code, instead of in SharePoint.

internal_notes: Repo and development docs live in the repo. Internal-only detail such as the full LMS inventory lives in the private organisation GitHub repository, and agents never hand documents off to SharePoint.
The Cloudron guide records that the old holding page files were removed after a backup, and uses maintenance mode for taking the site offline.
